mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates an accommodative monetary environment that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 6.0% indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the real economy, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 and HOUST both decline from their 3-month prior values.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent slowdown in manufacturing, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines in the late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation rate (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) indicates stable price levels, which reduces uncertainty about future corporate margins and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment growth rate below 0.1% per month signals weak labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in consumer and housing demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both decline from their 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a concurrent decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals that rate hikes are cooling the economy without causing stagflation, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0 and CPIAUCSL declines.
